**Front lines take the colour of whoever holds each city.** In a warzone unit split between two sides (for example Ishval held by one side and its neighbours by the other) the line now leaves each city in its own holder's colour, instead of the whole unit taking the majority colour. A link between two cities of the same unit held by different sides is drawn as a front too. (For Minecraft 26.1.x, 26.2 and 26.3.)
